featured_reviews.name: Akshaya Surendran
featured_reviews.review_text:
“I was able to do the headstand in the headstand workshop I attended today. Thank you, sir. You encouraged me a lot. It was a very good class.
Your guidance and clear instructions made it much easier for me to learn. I feel more confident now to practice headstand regularly. I truly appreciate your patience and motivation throughout the session. Looking forward to attending more classes like this in the future.” 😊

featured_reviews.name: anupama reddy
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended a headstand session with yoga teacher Mr. Ritesh Rao, and as a total beginner, I found it incredibly helpful. Before this class, I had only practiced wall stands a few times with the help of a yoga stand, and I was never able to do a headstand without support.

During the one-hour session, Mr. Ritesh Rao provided clear instructions on hand and head placement and guided me through the tripod pose. His teaching style helped me overcome my fear and gain confidence in attempting the headstand. I now have a much better understanding of the technique, and I feel motivated to practice lifting my legs up and holding the position independently.

Mr. Ritesh Rao’s supervision and encouragement made a big difference in my progress. I am now more interested than ever in learning similar yoga skills and continuing my practice. This class was something I’ve wanted to do for years, and I’m grateful for his guidance and support. Highly recommended for anyone looking to learn headstands or other yoga skills. Thank you sir.

featured_reviews.name: REKHA SAKTHIVADIVEL
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended Ratish sir's headstand workshop and it was a really good experience.
What stood out to me was how clearly he covered the basics without rushing into the final pose. That strong foundation made me feel confident and safe. Even though it was an online session, his observation skills were excellent — he was able to notice small corrections and guide me so well.

Really grateful for the way he teaches — patient, structured and attentive. Looking forward to learning more from him!

featured_reviews.name: Deepukiran Garlapadu
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended a 1 hour workshop for headstands and I made progress with the tripod headstand and am extremely grateful to Ratish Rao ji for such a gently guided workshop with focus on the right alognment, patience and body awareness to make the right progress at the right time and individualised pace.

featured_reviews.name: Renjana Rishi
featured_reviews.review_text: Completed basic headstand session with Sir,simple techniques and not much of pressure or stress towards the achievement of basic asanas. Thank you so much. I have learnt to let go of the fear to practice without wall

I found Guru ji to be the most humble person and very approachable . After the workshop he was open to the questions which he answered very patiently. He made us practice step by step he paid individual attention to all of us
My best wishes and warm regards
Ritu Singh

featured_reviews.name: Nitya Sunil
featured_reviews.review_text: Esha from Shwetambari Yogshala has been my yoga teacher since 2017. She is an excellent teacher who has helped me greatly with my physical and mental health through yoga. Since 2019, Esha has taken online classes and accommodated different time zones to ensure continuity in my practice. To me, online classes have been as good as any live/physical class I have attended, as Esha spends time correcting our form and ensuring we do not overexert ourselves. The classes also helped in addressing my minor knee issue through strength building and focused asanas with adjustments to make sure I never overexert the knee. Esha does an amazing job of customising the practice based on my physical abilities and concerns. Yoga practice with Esha has helped me so much in being consistent and mindful about fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Lalit Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: The one-to-one yoga classes were great. The teacher provided by the Shwetambari Yogshala was professional and helped me with my problems in a very supportive way.

featured_reviews.name: Radha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Practicing yoga with Esha over the past four years has been a transformative part of my healing journey. Her knowledge in yoga philosophy & incredible patience have helped me reconnect with my body in ways I once thought was impossible.
What truly sets Esha apart is her commitment - she shows up consistently with minimal breaks, always holding space with presence. Her ability to customize each practice, each session to meet my physical & emotional needs has been a lifeline. Whether I needed gentle movement, stretch, grounding breathwork, or just the encouragement to keep me going, she offered it with grace.
Esha's classes are not just about yoga poses--they are about listening, honouring the body and finding peace within discomfort. I am stronger, more resilient,and more in tune with myself because of her.
If you're looking for a teacher who combines  deep wisdom with genuine care, Esha is a rare & beautiful guide. I am beyond grateful to be on this path with her❤️

featured_reviews.name: Kiara Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been doing personal yoga sessions with Esha for 6 months now and there’s definitely an improvement in my flexibility and strength. She is knowledgeable and makes you feel comfortable during the session. Her passion for yoga and overall wellness of her students is evident in her interactions and humble approach.

featured_reviews.name: Uma Ravirala
featured_reviews.review_text: Esha is an amazing instructor….she has extensive knowledge and she gives personal attention to each and everyone even in group of class. She not only teaches asanas but helps one understand the benefits behind each one of them. Very punctual. I am glad i started my yoga journey under her guidance, it has helped me a lot with physical strength, peace of mind and positivity.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Maelzer
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been doing yoga with Esha for more than 2 years now. These lessons have helped me achieve my goals of losing weight, building strength in my back and shoulders. It’s not just asana practice but also short yoga philosophy tips she gives that has helped me go deeper in my practice and apply yoga to my day to day life. She’s passionate and provides variations after researching, works and begins with whatever level you are at and aims to take you to the next level in your yoga practice.

featured_reviews.name: kuldeep j
featured_reviews.review_text:
Namaste!
I have been practicing yoga at Shwetambari Yogshala for the last two years. I learned and tried a lot of asanas which helped me to make my body flexible and mind calm especially after Spine surgery. Every class we learn/practice various asanas and meditation under a very good yoga instructor (Eesha)who is very engaging, knowledgeable, attentive and professional. This place is one of the best places to practice traditional yoga.
Keep up the good work Eesha Ma’am !!!

featured_reviews.name: Leslie joy alex
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning yoga with Shwetambari Yogashala for the last 15 months. Even though I was a beginner with no prior experience with yoga, I was able to make very good progress in a couple of months, thanks to the excellent instruction here. Prior to starting yoga practice, my joints and tendons were quite stiff and sore and I faced several issues due to long hours of sitting at my work station. The instruction at Shwetambari Yogashala helped me overcome these issues. I have especially enjoyed the group classes with my wife. The instructor has been very accommodative of abrupt schedule changes due to my work. I would recommend Shwetambbari Yogashala to anyone considering starting yoga.

A complete amalgamation of in depth yogic knowledge and asanas at a beautiful ambience.
I wanted to join yoga classes for 2 weeks as was travelling to mumbai from Uk.

Yoga teacher accommodated my request and totally made me feel at home. She is friendly, jovial and well versed!

As someone already into yoga for quite some time, and wanted to restart the journey after a long pause, I was looking for someone to guide me.

The ambience is roof top and very pleasant with morning chirping of birds, green trees and fresh air.

Focussing on my elevated stress levels and back issues, my instructor did complete justice by suggesting yoga poses which works wonderfully on the same.
It’s a complete package of relaxation session Infused with relevant information. Great for beginners and people looking for revision sessions.
Cons would be, the stairs for some ( which worked out for me as I looking to be fit :) )

I highly recommend these classes and would definitely come back for more!

featured_reviews.name: Akshaykumar Benvanshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 – Truly Transformative Experience at Premanand Yoga Institute

Premanand Yoga Institute is the perfect place for anyone looking not only for professional and personal fitness, but also for true self-improvement. The environment is positive, disciplined, and deeply inspiring.

The teachers here are exceptional. A special thanks to Sagar Jadhav Sir, Sarika Ma’am, and Bhavana Ma’am for guiding me so beautifully in my fitness journey and supporting my career goals. Their knowledge, dedication, and individual attention have genuinely helped me grow—physically, mentally, and professionally.

I highly recommend Premanand Yoga Institute to anyone who wants a life-changing yoga experience and a supportive space to become their best self.

featured_reviews.name: Sanchita Bhatkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently completed my Yoga Teacher Training Course here, and it was a wonderful experience. The instructors Nilesh sir ,Sagar sir,And Sarika mam were knowledgeable and supportive, Coordinator Bhavna Solanki mam and the course covered both practical and theoretical aspects very well.

The positive environment helped me grow in confidence and deepen my understanding of yoga. I would highly recommend this class to anyone looking to learn or teach yoga.

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Redkar
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a great experience with dadar premanand centre. front desk bhavna is supportive . I did 1yrs yoga teacher training diploma and and it's a good beginning to joining yoga classes I am loving it a lot best class 😊.............and trainer also

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Kotgire
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently completed the 6-month Yoga Teacher Training course and it was a wonderful experience. The trainers, Nilesh Sir and Sarika Mam, made the entire journey insightful and enriching.
Nilesh Sir is exceptionally good with practical sessions – his clear demonstrations and hands-on guidance helped me perfect my asanas and teaching skills with confidence. Sarika Mam brought great warmth and attention to detail, making complex concepts easy to understand.

featured_reviews.name: Rizwana Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Have been with this Institute for almost 3 months. My teacher Mr. Nilesh Yadav is young energetic and very knowledgeable. Helped me to polish my yoga experience. Great Teacher👍.  Bhavana is a manager I must she is empathetic person. That's what make the energy of the place welcoming and   peaceful. Keep up the good work 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Utekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I truly learned Yoga theoretically as well as practically coming here. Trainers like nilesh sir and sagar sir are well versed in teaching as well pay attention on an individual level too! Would definitely recommend everyone to start their yoga teacher training course, thank you for the teachings and support!

featured_reviews.name: rameshwari wadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have taken 1year of course and my trainer is nilesh Yadav and he has lots of knowledge of yoga. He teaches all the yogas and asnas very accurately and if we are not able to do it properly he motivate us help us . Apart from this he also makes yoga very enjoyable so that we can get more active .my overall experience with this class is very nice and that's just because of my trainer nilesh yadav.
Thanks premanand yoga and trainer nilesh yadav.

featured_reviews.name: Ranjit kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been practicing under sagar Sir at Premanand Yoga, Dadar, and it's been a truly transformative experience. His teaching style is calm, knowledgeable, and deeply rooted in traditional yoga, yet very practical for modern lifestyles. Each session feels balanced — focusing on strength, flexibility, breath, and inner awareness.
Sagar Sir pays personal attention to every student and ensures correct posture and alignment, which makes a huge difference.
